_pending_upstream_note: Cases 'routing-session-vs-stateless' and 'server-js-session-traps' depend on unreleased @auth0/auth0-server-js per-request options (PR #230 / #244). They will fail until those PRs are released and the SDK version is updated in the skill references.

evals.expected_output: Uses AuthClient.getTokenByRefreshToken({ refreshToken: rt }), reads tokens.accessToken, and computes the stored deadline as tokens.expiresAt * 1000 WITHOUT adding Date.now() (expiresAt is already an absolute Unix timestamp).
Migrates to @auth0/auth0-auth-js AuthClient.getTokenByClientCredentials({ audience }); reads tokens.accessToken directly (no .data envelope).
Uses getTokenByPassword, reads tokens.accessToken, and detects MFA with isMfaRequiredError(e) instead of AuthApiError + string comparison.
Uses AuthClient.getTokenByCode(url, ...) passing the full callback URL (not req.query.code), and stores the returned TokenResponse fields; keeps the app's own session as-is (auth-js, not server-js).
Migrates only the AuthenticationClient usage to @auth0/auth0-auth-js; keeps the ManagementClient import and usage from 'auth0' untouched.

Routes to @auth0/auth0-server-js (NOT auth-js) because the app has a redirect login flow, manages a session across requests, and refreshes tokens. Replaces the hand-rolled session/refresh logic with ServerClient: startInteractiveLogin for /login, completeInteractiveLogin for /callback (which persists the session), and getAccessToken for /api/data (which auto-refreshes). No manual expiresAt arithmetic or .data access remains.
evals._pending: Requires unreleased per-request options from auth0-server-js PR #230/#244

evals.expected_output: Uses ServerClient.completeInteractiveLogin(callbackUrl, storeOptions) to exchange the code, validate the ID token, and persist the session to the state store in one call. The session is written by the SDK, not manually assigned to req.session. No .data envelope, no manual expiresAt arithmetic (the SDK stores expiresAt as an absolute Unix timestamp internally), and no hand-rolled session object construction.
